en.summary: The repository shows high popularity with over 2,900 stars, but recent inactivity and basic hygiene/content issues suggest reduced maintenance. Reported issues point to committed system clutter (.DS_Store) and suspicious external links.
signals: High star count (2,905) and fork count (479) indicate wide reach.
Last push was 95 days ago, showing a lack of recent maintenance.
Issues highlight repository hygiene flaws (unfiltered .DS_Store files) and potentially problematic external links ('lostsec.xyz').
Relatively low watcher count (28) compared to stars.
